description:
1 no. Illuminated projecting sign: Fabricated mild steel frame and fixings, with folded aluminium stencil cut panels in bronze finish, and halo illumination in 2200k warm white LED lighting giving letter and logo edge & halo illumination only. Projecting sign dimensions: 750 mm (H) x 566 mm (W) x 75 mm (D).  

1 no. Fascia sign: Halo illuminated stainless steel flat faced lettering in white. Fascia sign dimensions: 240 mm (H) x 2460 mm (W) x 70 mm (D). 

1 no. Menu box: Wall mounted stainless steel menu case in bronze finish, halo lit with 2200k LED strip lighting and 5mm opal acrylic diffuser. Menu box dimensions: 600 mm (H) x 420 mm (W) x 85 mm (D).  

4 no. Window manifestations: Gold vinyl horseman logo. Window manifestation logo dimensions: 520 mm (H) x 460 mm (W).  

4 no. Window manifestations: Gold vinyl lettering. Window manifestation lettering dimensions: 1. 105 mm (H) x 1080 mm (W). 2. 105 mm (H) x 1215 mm (W). 3. 105 mm (H) x 790 mm (W). 4. 105 mm (H) x 540 mm (W). 

7 no. Window manifestations: Gold vinyl pattern. Window manifestation pattern dimensions: 1. 450 mm (H) x 2020 mm (W). 2. 450 mm (H) x 800 mm (W). 3. 450 mm (H) x 800 mm (W). 4. 450 mm (H) x 2020 mm (W). 5. 450 mm (H) x 2010 mm (W).  6. 450 mm (H) x 2010 mm (W).  7. 450 mm (H) x 2010 mm (W).
decision_conditions:
The illumination of the sign(s) is to be by fixed and constant lights and not by lights which are or appear to be intermittent, moving, flashing or vibrating lights.
REASON: To ensure that the proposed development does not prejudice the appearance of the locality.
